methods.label: Update each investment year by year
methods.explanation:
Each second-year percentage applies to the value after the first year, so calculate the two years in order.

AA first gains \(20\%\) of \(100\), reaching \(120\) dollars. It then loses \(20\%\) of \(120\), which is \(24\) dollars. Thus
\[
A=120-24=96.
\]
BB first loses \(25\%\) of \(100\), leaving \(75\) dollars. It then gains \(25\%\) of \(75\), which is \(18.75\) dollars. Thus
\[
B=75+18.75=93.75.
\]
CC remains unchanged throughout, so \(C=100\).

Since \(93.75<96<100\), the final values satisfy \(B<A<C\), choice E.
